tieu_de: Pluto transit through the 11th house: the company you keep changes you
mo: Why am I losing touch with old friends?
How can I tell if a powerful new contact is good for me?
Is this a good time to join a group or cause?

You can often trace the biggest changes of this period back to a person you met at a group, a friend of a friend, or an organisation you joined almost by accident. With Pluto in the 11th house, transformation comes through networks. The people around you gain influence over where your life goes next.
That influence can lift you a long way. It can also lead you somewhere you would not have chosen on your own, which is why choosing your circles carefully matters so much right now.

doan: The 11th house covers friends, groups, communities, professional networks, causes and long-term hopes. Pluto brings depth, power and renewal. In this house, it reshapes your social world and, through it, your sense of what future you are working toward.
Pluto tends to bring powerful people into the 11th house story. Some become mentors or allies who open doors. Others have agendas that do not serve you.
Planet Pluto Rules Scorpio Transformation, rebirth, power
Friendships change. Some long-standing ones fade because you no longer share the same values. New ones form quickly and intensely, often around shared goals or causes.

You may join an organisation, a movement or an online community that becomes central to your life. Or you may leave one that you have been part of for years, sometimes after a falling out over power or direction.

People with real influence may take an interest in you. A single introduction can lead to a new career path or project. At the same time, you may notice group dynamics more sharply: who leads, who follows, who is being used.

This is a strong period for building a network that supports your long-term plans. The right contacts can create a turning point in your life and work. Collaborations formed now can have lasting effect.
It is also a time to rethink your hopes. Goals set years ago may no longer fit, and Pluto pushes you to replace them with ones that reflect who you are becoming.

The main risk is being drawn in or used. Groups with unhealthy aims, charismatic figures with hidden motives, or friends who want more than they give can pull you off course. Pluto makes such influences stronger, which means they need more scrutiny.
Power struggles within groups are also common. You may find yourself fighting for control of a committee or project, or pushed out by someone else doing the same.

Pluto spends 12 to 30 years in a sign, and a house transit usually runs on a similar order. The width of your 11th house depends on your house system and birth latitude, so your chapter may be shorter or longer than average. Pluto's retrograde periods can bring certain friendships or group issues back more than once.
Be selective. Before committing time or money to a group, look at how it treats its members and where its leadership takes it.
Keep some distance from people who push you to act against your own judgement, however impressive they seem.
Invest in relationships with people who help you grow. Offer the same in return: the best alliances of this transit are mutual.
Stop staying in circles only out of loyalty to the past. Start writing down what you hope for over the next decade and look for people heading in the same direction.

As Pluto changes your values and goals, some friendships no longer fit. This is often a natural sorting rather than anyone's fault. The friendships that survive tend to be the ones built on real common ground.

Watch what happens over time. Healthy influence leaves you more capable and more yourself. Unhealthy influence leaves you dependent, isolated or acting against your own values. Trust the pattern rather than the charm.
Yes, if you choose with care. Communities can be a major source of transformation now. Look for groups with open leadership and clear aims, and keep your own judgement even as you commit.
